messages:
Maya K.: Heads-up — we're planning a rate-card switchover next Wed to the new pricing schema (internal v2.1). Need alignment on active POCs, signed commits, and any legacy special terms. TL;DR: minimize surprises for customers.

Raj P.: Quick q — for POCs already running, do we keep them on current pricing until their POC end date, or do we migrate them to v2.1 immediately? Some reps are worried about churn if pricing jumps mid-POC. :eyes:

Olivia (sales-ops): Our default preference is to keep an active POC on the price it started with until completion, then apply new rate for renewals. Need Deal Desk confirmation for any exceptions.

Deal Desk: Confirming policy draft: honor pricing for active, signed POCs through their agreed end-date. For verbal or informal POCs, require the AE to log a transition plan in Zendesk + tag @deal-desk. Exceptions: discounts >25% or multi-region private deployments require manager approval. If you need to lock in old rates for a renewal, submit a Deal Request with commit_id and justification.

Sam T.: We have two customers (ACME + Nimbus) mid-POC with quoted committed units under the old grid. ACME's legal wants the old numbers in writing for conversion. Can Deal Desk pre-approve a 90-day bridge so we can send a one-pager?

Deal Desk: Yes — provide the commit_id and the exact unit/month and term. For bridges up to 90 days we can approve at manager level if discount delta <= 15%. Anything larger needs Pricing WG sign-off.

Pricing WG: To reduce manual churn, we're introducing a short-lived "grace mapping" that will translate v2.0 commit SKUs to v2.1 equivalents for billing systems. Example mapping snippet:
```
# pseudo mapping
old_sku: rwd-small-1
new_sku: rwd-core-1
grace_days: 90
max_discount_allowed: 15
```
This is a temporary layer we enable per-account when Deal Desk authorizes it.

Maya K.: Two asks: 1) Sales, compile a list of active POCs with expected end dates by EOD Fri; include commit_id if any. 2) Ops (Olivia) — please draft a one-page template for a 90-day bridge and a checklist for approvals.

Olivia (sales-ops): Will do. I'll post the template in #sales-docs and link it here.

Raj P.: Also flag any POCs that are on Dedicated or Private — those need eng validation for SKU mapping before we issue any bridge.

Sam T.: Noted — adding ACME + Nimbus to the list and marking ACME as Private.

Deal Desk: Process reminder: submit requests via /deal-request with tag "rate-switchover". For urgent escalations use the deal-desk channel and include the commit_id + customer legal contact.

Maya K.: Thanks all. We'll hold an optional 30-min sync Mon morning for reps with active POCs. If you can't make it, drop the list in this thread. :thumbsup:
